title: Cross-lane relationship admission proposal gate

relationshipKinds.label: Candidate molecular-label correspondence
relationshipKinds.boundary: A shared or mapped label is not a same-cell identity, source-object link, spatial coordinate or biological truth claim.

relationshipKinds.label: Candidate source-object derivation
relationshipKinds.boundary: A catalog source record is not proof that an unacquired source object was used to derive a project record.

relationshipKinds.label: Candidate same-specimen relation
relationshipKinds.boundary: Matching species, segment, condition, label or study does not establish a shared specimen.

relationshipKinds.label: Candidate coordinate transform
relationshipKinds.boundary: A visual overlay, common anatomy or author-space coordinates do not establish a source-to-project transform or registration.

relationshipKinds.label: Candidate same-cell identity
relationshipKinds.boundary: A cell class, marker overlap, classifier output or one study observation does not establish that two records are the same cell.

nonPromotionPolicy: A proposal is a local, incomplete review record only. It cannot add a cross-lane edge, alter a trace, change a source admission status or entity identity, acquire a source object, grant reuse rights, establish biological truth, or create REG.
scientificBoundary: This composer records declared package-level identifiers and missing admission evidence. It does not inspect, hash, transform, align, combine, analyze, persist or bundle a source object; it does not establish identity, coordinates, a source-to-project relationship, or registration.
